prompt:
Create an exactly 30-second vertical 9:16 premium 3D animated adventure-comedy short. Use the attached @ Koda character sheet as the exact visual reference for Koda. Maintain his identical face, amber-brown eyes, cream facial markings, rust-red fur, dark legs, rounded ears, compact proportions and enormous ringed fluffy tail throughout every frame. The reference defines Koda's appearance only.
The entire story takes place on one continuous sunny green mountain hillside surrounded by distant forested mountains. One old peach tree grows from the slope. It has a thick stable trunk, several strong main branches and one thinner flexible outer branch. One enormous ripe golden-orange peach hangs near the end of that thinner branch. A large dense leafy bush grows directly below that side of the tree. A long fallen bamboo pole lies several meters away on the same hillside. Farther downhill, a narrow wooden footbridge crosses a shallow mountain stream. Keep this geography fixed throughout the entire video.
Koda desperately wants the enormous peach. His first idea is simply to climb the tree. He reaches the fruit but moves too far onto the thin outer branch, causing the branch to bend gradually under his weight. He almost touches the peach, loses traction and slides off into the huge soft bush below. Koda refuses to give up. He returns with the long fallen bamboo pole, places it diagonally against a strong fork in the tree and climbs it like a simple ladder. This time he reaches the peach and pulls it free. The peach is far heavier than expected, drops onto the clearly sloping hillside and begins rolling downhill because of gravity. Koda chases it, jumps onto the rolling fruit and accidentally begins riding it. He becomes thrilled and celebrates until he notices a narrow wooden footbridge directly ahead. The peach is much wider than the bridge entrance. It wedges between the entrance posts, stops instantly and Koda's forward momentum sends him harmlessly into a giant pile of dry leaves beside the bridge.
Open at 0:00 with a low wide tracking shot of Koda already sprinting uphill through tall green grass toward the peach tree. His short legs move rapidly and his huge fluffy tail streams naturally behind him. As he reaches the tree, he suddenly looks upward and sees the enormous peach glowing among the leaves. He skids to a stop, stares at it, looks at the trunk and immediately becomes determined.
From 0:02 to 0:05, follow Koda as he rapidly climbs the thick trunk using all four paws. His claws visibly grip the bark while his hind feet push upward. His tail stays naturally attached behind him and reacts only to his body movement. He pulls himself onto a strong main branch and begins moving toward the peach.
From 0:05 to 0:08, show a clear wide side view of Koda carefully stepping from the thick branch onto the thinner outer branch. The peach is just beyond his reach. As Koda moves farther away from the trunk, his weight causes the thin branch to bend downward gradually. The branch does not bend before Koda steps onto it and does not move for any unexplained reason.
From 0:08 to 0:11, Koda slowly stretches one front paw toward the peach. His paw almost reaches it. He leans slightly farther forward and briefly touches the peach's fuzzy surface. He smiles. His rear paws then lose traction on the increasingly sloped branch. Koda freezes, his eyes widen and he begins sliding backward along the branch.
From 0:11 to 0:13, Koda slides completely off the branch and falls directly downward into the large dense bush below. He disappears into the foliage with a huge soft leafy FWUMP. The bush shakes. After a short comedic pause, Koda's head slowly rises from between the leaves. Small leaves cling to his fur. He looks upward toward the peach again and his dazed expression changes into stubborn determination.
From 0:13 to 0:16, Koda jumps from the bush, runs several meters across the same hillside and grabs the end of the long fallen bamboo pole using both front paws. He drags it across the grass toward the peach tree. The bamboo scrapes naturally over the ground. Koda struggles because the pole is much longer than his body, but he never uses or removes his tail as a tool.
From 0:16 to 0:18.5, show the complete setup clearly in one wide shot. Koda positions one end of the bamboo on the grassy ground near the tree. He lifts the other end with both front paws while the grounded end remains in contact with the earth. As Koda walks forward underneath the rising pole, the bamboo rotates upward around its grounded end until the raised end settles securely against a strong fork in the thick tree. The bamboo now forms a stable diagonal climbing pole. Koda steps back, studies it and smiles proudly.
From 0:18.5 to 0:21, Koda climbs the angled bamboo with all four paws. His front paws pull while his hind feet push against the bamboo surface. The bamboo remains stable against the tree. His fluffy tail remains physically connected to his body and trails naturally behind him. He reaches the upper end beside the enormous peach.
From 0:21 to 0:23.5, Koda braces his hind feet against the bamboo and grabs the peach with both front paws. He pulls once and nothing happens. He adjusts his grip and pulls much harder. The short fruit stem stretches under the force. With one final effort the stem breaks with a clear POP. Koda is suddenly holding the enormous peach and gives a huge triumphant smile.
From 0:23.5 to 0:25.5, the peach's weight immediately pulls downward. Koda cannot support it. The peach slips from his paws and drops onto the steep grassy slope below with a heavy THUMP. Because the ground visibly slopes downhill, the peach naturally begins rolling. It starts slowly and then accelerates. Koda quickly descends from the bamboo and runs after it.
From 0:25.5 to 0:27.5, use a dynamic downhill tracking shot. The enormous peach rolls rapidly through the grass. Koda catches up and jumps onto its upper surface. At first he lies belly-first and panics, but after a moment he gets his paws underneath himself and manages to balance on top. His expression changes from fear to pure excitement. He stretches his front paws outward while his huge attached tail streams behind him. Koda begins enjoying the ridiculous ride.
From 0:27.5 to 0:29, track backward in front of the rolling peach. Koda rides proudly with a huge smile while his fur moves in the rushing air. He suddenly looks ahead. His smile disappears. Pull the camera backward enough to reveal the narrow wooden footbridge directly downhill. The entrance is obviously narrower than the giant peach. Koda's eyes widen. He has no time to stop.
From 0:29 to 0:30, show the bridge entrance in a clear wide side view. The rolling peach reaches the two wooden entrance posts and wedges firmly between them with one heavy THUD. The peach stops instantly. Koda's momentum carries him forward off the fruit and into a large soft pile of dry leaves beside the bridge. Leaves burst upward around him. His head immediately rises from the pile, completely unharmed and dazed. One small green peach leaf drifts down and lands gently on top of his head. Koda slowly looks upward with only his eyes. Cut to black.
Use a premium photorealistic 3D CGI animated-feature aesthetic with detailed soft fur, realistic bark, leaves, grass and peach fuzz, cinematic daylight, rich natural colors and expressive physical comedy. Keep the daylight warm and consistent. Use believable gravity, momentum, friction, collisions and character weight beneath the exaggerated comedy.
Koda has exactly one fluffy tail, permanently attached to the base of his spine throughout all 30 seconds. Never detach it, duplicate it, turn it into a prop or place it in Koda's paws. Koda manipulates objects only with his paws and body weight.
The peach remains attached to the same branch until Koda physically pulls it free. The thin branch bends only because Koda moves his weight farther outward. The bamboo moves only because Koda physically drags and raises it. The peach rolls only after falling onto the visibly downhill slope. The peach continuously travels downhill toward the existing bridge. Do not teleport objects, change geography, create duplicate props or introduce unexplained movement.
No humans, no additional animals, no dialogue, no text, no subtitles, no logos and no HUD.
Use playful adventurous orchestral music throughout. Include rapid soft paw footsteps, mountain wind, grass and leaf movement, claw-on-bark sounds, subtle branch creaking, the soft leafy FWUMP of Koda landing in the bush, bamboo scraping over grass, bamboo contact sounds, the fruit-stem POP, heavy peach THUMP, increasing rolling rumble, stronger wind during the downhill ride, an abrupt musical stop when Koda sees the bridge, a heavy THUD when the peach wedges between the posts, a soft POOF when Koda lands in the leaves, brief silence, gentle leaf flutter and one tiny comedic orchestral note when the peach leaf lands on Koda's head.
